dedupe_keys.name: scot deplacement reseau de transport collectif du cg86

description: SCOT - DEPLACEMENT - Réseau de transport collectif du CG86 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. This dataset represents the entire interurban transport network of the General Council of Vienna operating between 2008 and August 2015. It lists the stopping points and the route of the commercial and school lines. This file cannot be distributed, turn directly to CG86. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "SCOT - TRAVEL - CG86 Public Transit Network" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include lignes en Vienne, car, autobus, transport scolaire, autocar, réseau du CG86. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
